items.title: Neville's Man Utd warning: 'Get a grip or face worrying few weeks'
items.summary: Gary Neville warned Manchester United could be in for a "worrying few weeks" if their players don't "get a grip" on their season after they were booed in their draw with Tottenham.

items.title: Boos, anguish & fading belief -'worrying day' for under-pressure Carrick
items.summary: It couldn't happen again could it? Another failure to beat 10 men increases pressure on Man Utd boss Michael Carrick after a 1-1 draw against Tottenham Hotspur.

items.title: 'I kissed Rodrigo and said thanks' - De Zerbi 'liked' Spurs red card
items.summary: Roberto de Zerbi praises Rodrigo Bentancur after he was sent off in a 1-1 draw against Manchester United.

items.title: 'It hurts a lot' - Carrick 'understands' Man Utd boos after draw
items.summary: Manchester United head coach Michael Carrick says boos from the club's fans 'hurts a lot' but that he and his team 'must cope with it' after they conceded a late equaliser to draw 1-1 with Tottenham in the Premier League.

items.title: 'Tottenham needs this reaction' - De Zerbi defends Bentancur red
items.summary: Tottenham Hotspur head coach Roberto De Zerbi says the decision to send off Rodrigo Bentancur was correct, but admitted he liked that his player showed a 'reaction', adding he wants to see more of that attitude from his squad, following their 1-1 draw at Manchester United in the Premier League.

items.title: Portugal suspend Cristiano Ronaldo after walking out on national team
items.summary: Federation opens disciplinary proceedings Veteran has been critical of coach Jorge Jesus Cristiano Ronaldo has been provisionally suspended as the Portuguese football federation (FPF) opened disciplinary proceedings against the 41-year-old after his decision to walk out on the national team .
